text:
Marta (Talent Ops): Morning team — prepping logistics for Sam's hybrid interview on Tue 10/12. Quick checklist: building entry, parking, dietary needs, and a backup plan if he arrives late. Posting details below.

Marta (Talent Ops): Schedule (local time):
- 09:30 — Candidate arrival / badge pickup at lobby desk
- 09:45 — Welcome + 20m intro with Owen
- 10:15 — Technical panel (onsite + Zoom)
- 11:30 — Lunch (hosted)
- 12:15 — Final wrap + recruiter check-out

Marta (Talent Ops): Zoom link for remote panelists: https://zoom.redwood.example/j/987654321 — passcode: 4201

Marta (Talent Ops): Building access: entrance B (loading dock side) — guest buzzer then lobby will issue temporary badge. If he's driving, Noah will reserve spot P2 with permit code `VISITOR-1789`.

Owen (Hiring Manager): I can take the 09:45 intro and stay for the tech panel. Can the panelists get the candidate's resume a bit earlier?

Marta (Talent Ops): Yes — sending resume bundle to panel at 08:30 with prep notes.

Noah (Facilities): Confirmed parking P2 saved for 09:00–13:00. Permit: VISITOR-1789. Gate code: `#2246` (enter then swipe). Lobby has a peg for coats.

Sam (Candidate): Thanks — a quick Q: I'm gluten-free. Also, I might be 10–15m late due to a flight delay. Is there a backup?

Marta (Talent Ops): Noted — will order GF lunch and snacks. If you're 10–15m late we can shift intro to 09:55 and keep panel start at 10:15 (we'll absorb the late buffer). If >20m late we'll run intro remotely and join the panel via Zoom.

Owen (Hiring Manager): That's fine. If he's >20m late ping me and I'll move his intro to after the panel.

Marta (Talent Ops): Point of contact on the day: me (Slack: @marta) or Noah on-site. We'll send a same-day confirmation text to Sam with door/buzzer instructions.

HR Bot: Automated reminder scheduled: candidate-event-1789123456 will send SMS at 08:00 day-of.

Sam (Candidate): Appreciate it — please send SMS. Also, is there an NDA to sign on arrival?

Marta (Talent Ops): We'll email an e-sign NDA link ahead of time (08:30) and have a paper copy at check-in as fallback.

Noah (Facilities): One more: the interview room AV check is at 09:00; Owen, can you confirm the laptop HDMI adapter?

Owen (Hiring Manager): I'll bring USB-C -> HDMI and test screen share at 08:50.

Marta (Talent Ops): Great. I'll update the candidate doc and send a final confirmation message tonight. :thumbsup:

Sam (Candidate): Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

Marta (Talent Ops): Done — final confirmation scheduled for 18:00 today with parking, buzzer, Zoom fallback, and dietary note.

Marta (Talent Ops): Thread closed unless there are other reqs.
